## What changed

0.3.5 is in the index at `https://hotloop.io/hotloop-codesys/`, published on 2026-11-16, and it is the chart to install.

- **It wraps HotLoop 4.20.2,** which carries the EtherNet/IP batch fix and a `version` command that prints with no configuration. The provisioner stays on 0.3.1.
- **Everything in [0.3.2](/releases/codesys-0-3-2/) to [0.3.4](/releases/codesys-0-3-4/) is still here,** nothing writes to the PLC, and every earlier chart stays in the index.

What it means for you: this is the one to install, and an upgrade from 0.3.4 keeps your device and its tags.

## What was checked

An upgrade from 0.3.4 with a profile applied to 0.3.5, with a CODESYS Control for Linux SL 4.22.0.0 runtime on the node's network beside it: one new pod on 4.20.2 came up, the device and its 44 tags were still there and none writable, the page answered, and the HotLoop log had no warnings or errors. Both pods deleted and the runtime restarted: all three came back by themselves. It has been run on bare metal (2026-11-17).
